title: Use the Command Palette
summary: The Command Palette searches editor actions by name. It is useful when you do not remember a menu location.

blocks.title: Use the Command Palette

blocks.text: The palette helps find actions. A command's availability can depend on the current file and installed extensions.

blocks.text: Read a command before running it; similar names can do different things.
